roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search Platform

bullets: Own the enterprise roadmap: what we build for large customers, in what order, and why.
Own the platform behind it: organizations and identity, keys and quotas, spend controls, usage observability and audit, policy enforcement, and data residency.
Make product decisions on our API surface for enterprise use, so that the developers inside those accounts can build on us without friction.
Work with customer success, sales, and forward-deployed engineering to understand what enterprise customers need, and spend time in accounts alongside them to see it first hand.
Tell the difference between a single-account request and a pattern worth building for, and be able to defend the call either way.

roles.title: Director of Product, Ecosystem
roles.location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States; United States

bullets: Own the product vision, priorities, and roadmap for emerging opportunities in agentic infrastructure.
Work directly with developers and enterprise teams to understand their workflows, technical constraints, and unmet needs.
Translate customer insights and ecosystem developments into clear product decisions and scoped releases.
Partner with engineering and design throughout discovery, development, launch, and iteration.
Define success through developer adoption, production usage, customer outcomes, and business impact.
Own the roadmap and outcomes for a part of the inference platform, aligning several cross-functional engineering teams across advanced model optimization, inference performance…
Work with engineering and research to make inference more scalable, reliable and cost-efficient, and turn that into capabilities customers can depend on.
Stay close to customers through research, interviews and hands-on PoCs, especially in managed enterprise.
Track the market: open-source models, inference economics, and how businesses actually apply AI. Turn what you see into product bets.
